title: Solving Finite-sum Coupled Compositional Optimization via Multi-block-Single-probe Estimator
abstract: arXiv:2609.15723v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional variance reduction methods (e.g., SPIDER, SARAH, STORM) have been extensively investigated for improving the convergence rates of stochastic optimization. These techniques typically maintain a sequence of estimators for a single function (or gradient) across iterations. However, what if we need to track multiple functions, but can only access stochastic samples of $\mathcal{O}(1)$ functions at each iteration? This scenario arises in an important emerging family of finite-sum coupled compositional optimization (FCCO) problems of the form $\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^m f_i(g_i(\mathbf{w}))$, where each $g_i$ is accessible only through a stochastic oracle. translated_title: 基于多块单探测估计器求解有限和耦合复合优化问题
translated_abstract: 传统的方差缩减方法（如SPIDER、SARAH、STORM）已被广泛研究用于提升随机优化的收敛速度。这些技术通常在迭代过程中维护针对单个函数（或梯度）的一系列估计器。然而，如果我们需要跟踪多个函数，但每次迭代只能访问O(1)个函数的随机样本，该怎么办？这种情况出现在一类重要的新兴问题——有限和耦合复合优化（FCCO）问题中，其形式为(1/m)∑f_i(g_i(w))，其中每个g_i只能通过随机预言机访问。关键挑战在于如何随时间跟踪g(w)=(g_1(w), ..., g_m(w))，其中g(w)包含m个块，但每一步只能探测其中O(1)个块的随机值。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种...（原文摘要不完整，在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出多块单探测估计器，解决了有限和耦合复合优化问题中每次迭代仅能探测O(1)个函数块的挑战，实现了对m块向量g(w)的高效随机跟踪。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-block-single-probe estimator to solve finite-sum coupled compositional optimization (FCCO) problems, enabling efficient stochastic tracking of the m-block vector g(w) when only O(1) blocks can be probed per iteration.
